title: The Singhs Choose Shahidi Over Escape

blocks.text: After the first blows, the story pauses to weigh outcomes, reporting hui châlŵ phujdâr murd utrayô kambó ki jai while the Singhs measure what remains possible against what honour requires.

Their answer is not strategic withdrawal but theological clarity: ham lar turak jitai nahi jahin is joined to singh sôû ju karai nit janga, defining the Singh through constant struggle rather than protected survival.
The decisive note is martyrdom itself, because jin hônâ hai ihân shahida shows the companions affirming shahidi as the truthful end of the path they already chose.
